Alisha: Quick preflight for tomorrow's announce. We need: final changelog URL, canonical docs link, two bench bullets for the blog, webinar CTA copy, and where webinar signups route. Who takes what?
Tom: I can do changelog + docs PR. Will drop links in ~25m.
Renee: Ill draft webinar CTA + landing page. Hold copy until we have bench numbers.
Alisha: Canary timing? Ops window? Need an explicit rollback threshold to put in the changelog.
Ops-bot: Canary reserved 09:00 PT -> 09:30 monitor; ramp 50% 09:45; full 10:30. Auto-rollback if error spike >3% for 5m.
Tom: Changelog PR created: https://git.company/release/1765432/CHANGELOG.md (WIP). Docs PR: https://docs.company/pull/6543.
Docs-bot: Docs CI passed     PR ready to merge after +1.
Renee: CTA draft: "Join our launch webinar  learn how up to 2x throughput and ~30% lower per-token cost help you ship faster." Using "up to" until benches confirm. Feedback?
Alisha: Good. Bench owners please confirm numbers so we can lock copy. Also add a short security one-liner for Private customers in the slides.
Tom: Bench tagged in PR comments. Added canary + rollback snippet to changelog. Final docs link (post-merge): https://docs.company/release/1765432
Renee: Landing page wired to HubSpot webhook: https://hooks.hubspot.com/forms/1765432. Added hidden utm=launch_1765432. Webinar slot 45m, demo owner = Tom.
Alisha: Inbound routing plan: webhook -> HubSpot list 'launch_1765432' -> SDR queue -> 24h follow-up SLA. I'll circulate the short email template.
Tom: Merged docs. Use the docs URL above. Also added example client config to the docs: ```json
{"routingPolicy":"canary","fallback":"v1","canaryWindow":1800}
```
Alisha: Final copy freeze 16:00 PT. Prelaunch 15m check at 08:45 PT in #release-war-room. Thanks team :rocket:
